detail: Planner is scanning GitHub for the next review candidates. Candidate counts and shard details will be posted after planning completes.

next_actions.summary: Current GitHub state no longer satisfies the low-signal close policy.
next_actions.next_step: Leave the item open until a later review or live-state change makes it eligible.

cycle.label: 530 currently actionable close candidates (2 confirmed proposals, 267 guarded retries, 261/645 promotion probes admitted; 2 require proof; 569 cooldown-eligible backlog (284 promotions); 5 inconsistent or stale records excluded) at 276 records per latest cursor advance: about 2 windows; scheduled cadence alone would take roughly 30 min at 15-minute intervals, while successful windows can continue sooner.
